description:
Perform a graph inference task in the 'demodb' travel agency database to find potential travel companions.

First, seed the scenario by manually creating two new reviews for 'Hotel Artemide' on the date '2023-12-25':
1. One review by 'john.smith@example.com' (5 stars, 'Great Xmas!').
2. One review by 'maria.garcia@example.com' (5 stars, 'Lovely holiday!').
(Ensure these reviews are correctly linked: Profile -> MadeReview -> Review -> HasReview -> Hotel).

Next, create a new edge class named 'PotentialCompanion'.

Finally, write and execute a command (SQL or script) to find ALL pairs of users who have reviewed the SAME hotel on the SAME date. For every such pair found, create a 'PotentialCompanion' edge between them. The direction of the edge does not matter, but ensure they are linked.
